capabilities: Display a sidebar month calendar with Japanese public holidays highlighted
Show holiday names, substitute holidays and the Japanese era year
Mark dates that already have a daily note and preview them on hover
Open or create the daily note for a selected date
Configure week start, holiday names, era display and creation confirmation
disambiguation: Not a general calendar or scheduling tool; it only displays a month view of Japanese holidays and links to daily notes.
extras: Readme includes a full Japanese translation; roadmap mentions displaying calendrical notes (koyomi-chu) like 一粒万倍日 in v1.1; holidays are computed locally with no network access.
intentEvidence: Works with the core Daily notes plugin and with Periodic Notes
problem: Calendar views for daily notes don't show Japanese public holidays or the Japanese era year, and holidays are otherwise not visible when navigating daily notes.

relations.evidence: Works with the core Daily notes plugin and with Periodic Notes

summary: Sidebar month calendar showing Japanese public holidays, substitute holidays and the Japanese era year, where selecting a date opens or creates its daily note.
